analyst_view.overall: Girona (4th) and Eibar (5th) are level on 24 points, so this is a direct fight for the play-off places; Eibar are on a five-game winless run but are the sixth-best away side, and Girona have taken only 10 of their points at home. Girona are short at the back: Àlex Moreno is banned for a fifth yellow and Furtado, Bryan Gil and Jastin García are injured (all in the numbers), but Javi Boñar is also injured and Holmes Junior Zamorano is away with Spain Under-18, which reports say leaves just four fit defenders and may mean a first league start for Abdul Mumin. Eibar under Jokin Aranbarri have nearly a full squad, with only Imanol, Bernat and Gift working in the gym. The referee was not yet named when I checked.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and already add for Àlex Moreno's absence from Girona's defence. I lean slightly higher to about 2.3 because Girona are also without Boñar and Zamorano and may start Mumin, who has not started a league game this season after a long knee injury, against an Eibar side that has been creating plenty (35 shots on target in their last six).

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, already adding for Eibar conceding 44 corners in their last six. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards, close to a usual game. Aleix Garrido expects a match of many duels and the play-off stakes are real, but the referee is not yet known and the numbers already count both sides' recent cards, so I stay at 5.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.1 shots, already lifted for both sides' recent shooting. Girona's patched defence could give Eibar a little more, but Girona's attack (Vanat, Abel Ruiz, Carles Pérez) is intact, so I stay at 28.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. With Girona down to four fit defenders, beyond the ban the numbers count, Eibar's accurate recent shooting should find a little more, so I nudge it to about 9.4.
